name: Dafydd ap Gruffudd
text: Dafydd ap Gruffudd was the younger brother of Llywelyn ap Gruffudd. Writers usually reckon Llywelyn the last native prince of Wales. Dafydd served in that role for six months after him. His brief tenure closes the line of native Welsh princes.

attributes.attribute: younger brother of Llywelyn ap Gruffudd
served six months after Llywelyn as native prince of Wales

okr.objective: Record Dafydd ap Gruffudd, the short-lived last native prince of Wales.
key_results: Dafydd ap Gruffudd was the younger brother of Llywelyn ap Gruffudd.
He held the Welsh princedom for six months after his brother.
